'''Lakkna''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Gormak/Legends|Gormak]] [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] who lived on [[Voss]] during the [[Galactic War]]. After salvaging war [[Droid/Legends|droid]] parts from a crashed Imperial ship, she planned on rebuilding them and using these droids to crush the [[Voss (species)|Voss]]. She was stopped and killed by a Republic hero.
